name: The Shops at Cross Creek
summary: The Shops at Cross Creek is a community shopping center in Fulshear, Texas, managed by Phillips Edison & Company. Strategically located along FM 1463, it serves the rapidly growing residential communities of this sought-after Houston suburb with convenient retail, dining, and service options.
demographics: The Shops at Cross Creek serves the rapidly growing Fulshear community in Fort Bend County, attracting primarily upper-middle-class families with household incomes exceeding $100,000. The trade area consists of young professionals and families with children, drawn to the area's highly-rated schools and master-planned communities. Shoppers in this market segment prioritize convenience and quality, seeking everyday necessities alongside specialty retail and dining options close to their suburban homes.
description: The Shops at Cross Creek is a modern community shopping center located in the heart of Fulshear, Texas, one of the fastest-growing communities in the Greater Houston area. Situated at 6630 FM 1463 Road, this center serves the thriving residential developments that have transformed Fulshear from a small town into a sought-after suburban destination. Developed and managed by Phillips Edison & Company, a nationally recognized leader in grocery-anchored shopping center ownership and management, The Shops at Cross Creek provides essential retail, dining, and service options to the local community. The center's strategic location along FM 1463 positions it at the crossroads of new residential growth, making it a convenient stop for families and professionals living in nearby master-planned communities. With its focus on serving the daily needs of Fulshear residents, The Shops at Cross Creek has become an integral part of the community's retail landscape, offering a welcoming environment for shopping and gathering in this dynamic Texas suburb.
